name: meridian
description: Meridian — a modern city-building simulation. Build the city, then watch it come alive.

scripts.bench: rolldown bench/bigcity.ts --platform node --format esm -o bench/.out/bigcity.mjs --logLevel silent && node bench/.out/bigcity.mjs
scripts.bench:save: rolldown bench/makesave.ts --platform node --format esm -o bench/.out/makesave.mjs --logLevel silent && node bench/.out/makesave.mjs
scripts.check:geometry: rolldown bench/zfight.ts --platform node --format esm -o bench/.out/zfight.mjs --logLevel silent && node bench/.out/zfight.mjs
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.desktop:release: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run release
